overview.startPoint: Find a bear pelt while raiding the 1-11 frozen floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.

questReqs.text: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

notes: This guide is for 100% completion and to receive the unabridged tome. If the characters are having dialogue and the next door forward is open you can skip the dialogue and still get 100% completion.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

blocks.html: Right-click choose start saga on Skaldrun, choose the first option then Play Saga. (Note: If you found the bear skin a long time ago and forgot about it, there is a chance this is bugged.. You are best off talking to Skaldrun manually and asking about the bearskin and to tell you the story. This is how you know you've found it already and can start the saga)
